lyrics.text: 聆听最后一片花瓣，在月色中轻柔吐息
lyrics.sub_text: Listen as the final petal breathes softly in the moonlight

lyrics.text: 四季流转汇成终章，墨色夜空燃起流光
lyrics.sub_text: Turning seasons converge into the finale beneath ink skies

lyrics.text: 左手的脉搏与右手的轨迹，在此刻完全重叠
lyrics.sub_text: Pulse of the left hand and arc of the right become one

lyrics.text: 愿这首樱之终曲，伴你走过漫长星夜
lyrics.sub_text: May this sakura coda accompany you through the starry night
